help.title: Help centre
help.intro: Delivery, returns, warranties, payment: the answers to the questions we are asked most. Our team is available seven days a week.
help.notFoundTitle: Still not found what you need?
help.notFoundText: Our customer service answers Monday to Sunday, 9 am to 8 pm.

shipping.title: Delivery and tracking
shipping.a1: Orders confirmed before 3pm ship the same day for items marked "ships now". Allow 2 to 3 days for the north of the country, 3 to 5 days for the southern provinces.
shipping.a2: The fee depends on the province and municipality you are shipping to. It appears at checkout as soon as you pick your destination.
shipping.q3: How do I track my parcel?
shipping.a3: As soon as it ships, a tracking number appears on your order, under “My account” then “My orders”.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.q1: How long do I have to change my mind?
returns.a1: You have 30 days from delivery to change your mind, no reason needed. The product must be complete and in a condition that allows resale.
returns.q2: Do I pay for the return?
returns.a2: No. A prepaid label is provided on request from your order details.
returns.a3: Refunds are issued within 5 working days of us receiving and checking the product, to your original payment method.

warranty.title: Warranties
warranty.a1: New products carry a 24-month parts and labour warranty. Refurbished products carry the same 24 months; used products are covered for 6 months.
warranty.a2: It is our enhanced protection: payment is released to the seller only once the product is confirmed as described. In a dispute, Pravia refunds you in full.
warranty.a3: Every refurbished device passes 32 checkpoints. The battery is guaranteed at over 85% of its original capacity.

payment.title: Payment
payment.a1: Payment is in cash, on delivery. Nothing is charged when you order: the courier collects the amount when handing over your parcel.
payment.q2: Do I need an account to order?
payment.a2: No. Ordering takes no sign-up: first name, last name, province and municipality are enough. An account only helps you find your past orders later.

sellers.title: Become a seller
sellers.q1: How do I join the marketplace?
sellers.a1: Write to partners@pravia.com with your company registration number and your catalogue. Our team replies within 48 working hours.
sellers.a2: 8% of the sale price excluding delivery, with no subscription and no listing fees.
sellers.a3: Payouts are made twice a month, once the cooling-off period on the relevant orders has passed.

connections.title: External sign-in
connections.subtitle: Google, Microsoft, Facebook, TikTok and Apple.
connections.noneVisible: No button appears on the site
connections.withoutPasswordHint: Accounts reachable only through external sign-in
connections.localhostTitle: The site address still points to localhost.
connections.localhostText: The callback URLs below derive from it: set the real domain under SEO before registering the applications with the providers, otherwise the addresses will not match and sign-in will fail.
connections.configurationHint: Credentials live in environment variables, never in the database. On the server that is the .env.production file. A provider without credentials simply shows no button.
connections.callbackHint: It must match character for character. That is the first cause of failure.
connections.appleNote: Apple accepts no static secret: it is built for every exchange from the .p8 key. Paste its full content into APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY, headers included. Apple also requires an HTTPS callback URL, so Apple sign-in does not work from localhost.
connections.tiktokNote: TikTok sends no email address. It is asked from the visitor right afterwards, on a dedicated page, rather than being made up.
connections.noteGoogle: Credentials > Create OAuth client ID > Web application.
connections.noteMicrosoft: App registrations > New registration > Web. The secret expires, note its date.
connections.noteFacebook: “Facebook Login” product > Settings. The app must be in Live mode.
connections.noteTiktok: Add the Login Kit product and the user.info.basic scope.
connections.noteApple: Create a Services ID, enable Sign in with Apple, then a .p8 key.
